# Reach against the destination's own norm

## Rule
A published text whose reach falls below the destination's recorded norm is worth
noticing. It is never a reason to block, edit or replan anything.

## Criterion
Code compares the observed reach of the published text with the norm recorded for
that destination, and records the comparison. No threshold decides anything: I-12
means a soft signal acts on a number only where an owner approved one.

## Enforces
Nothing. It supports K-DST-LI-03 and the portfolio signals, as a hint.

## Route
| Finding | Route | Cause | Counter | On exhaustion |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| reach below the destination's recorded norm | hint | — | — | — |
| no norm recorded for the destination | hint | — | — | — |
